original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿克拉高等法院将于11月4日就Wontumi保释申请作出裁决
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳阿克拉高等法院定于2026年11月4日就前新爱国党（NPP）阿散蒂地区主席Bernard Antwi Boasiako（人称Wontumi主席）提出的保释申请作出裁决。该申请旨在就其因非法采矿相关罪名被定罪并判处20年监禁一事提出上诉期间获释。目前该消息为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 阿克拉高等法院定于2026年11月4日就Wontumi的保释申请作出裁决
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Accra High Court has set November 4, 2026, to deliver its ruling on a bail application filed by former New Patriotic Party (NPP) Ashanti Regional Chairman, Bernard Antwi Boasiako, popularly known as Chairman Wontumi.

key_facts.fact: Wontumi因非法采矿相关罪名被定罪并判处20年监禁，正就该判决提出上诉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The application seeks his release from custody pending an appeal against his conviction and 20-year prison sentence for illegal mining-related
